extra.fex_custom_note: Batman's container used a Custom FEX preset: original values plus Vector TSO, Memcpy TSO, and Half Barrier. Texture scrambling occurred regardless of FEX build, so no FEX build name is recorded here.

verification.notes: Nick Moody phone self-test, 2026-10-04 21:02. Epic copy launched from Batman's container via virtual desktop → D: → 0lego.bat (same as bm_lego.bat / lego_run.bat). Container stack as recorded: Proton 10.0-arm64x-2, DXVK 2.4.1-async, Turnip v26.1.0_b8, plus the container's custom FEX parameters. Intro rendering at 60 FPS, CPU 11%, GPU 72%. Gameplay, saving, and controller were not tested. The Epic library tile itself never launches (files downloaded, GameHub never marks the game installed). Do not start the same script through Run program.
known_issues: Texture scrambling (present in Batman's container on Proton 10.0-arm64x-2 + custom FEX, regardless of Turnip b6/b8, FEX build, or DXVK 2.3.1/2.4.1). Not present on the Proton 11.0-arm64x local-import defaults path.
Run program fails with DxvkInstance::createInstance: Failed to create Vulkan 1.1 instance. Launch lego_run.bat / 0lego.bat from D: inside the virtual desktop.
